title: Balloon: 120 Emote Sound Effects
shortText: 120 emote sound effects, one for each balloon, in 4 voices, with an MZ plugin.
html:
Balloon is a pack of 120 emote sound effects for RPG Maker MZ and any game engine: a cue for every speech balloon, in 4 matched voices.

Royalty free for commercial games, no credit required. A free demo of 18 sounds and the plugin is on this page.

@@IMG:shot_0_balloons.gif@@

What is inside

120 sounds · 14 emotes · 4 voices · 2 takes of each · WAV + OGG · 18 sound free demo

  • The ten stock balloons: exclamation, question, music note, heart, anger, sweat, frustration, silence, light bulb and Zzz, each numbered to its RPG Maker MZ balloon id.
  • Four more reactions: surprise, sparkle, gloom and blush, on ids 11 to 14, the rows the stock sheet leaves empty.
  • Four voices: soft cozy, retro chip, anime and wood and paper. Each plays the same gesture on its own instrument, so a question always rises and gloom always sags.
  • Two takes of every cue, different in length and in brightness, so characters reacting in turn do not repeat each other.
  • A balloon pop in and pop out in each voice.
  • A small RPG Maker MZ plugin: turn it on and Show Balloon Icon plays the matching cue by itself.

@@IMG:shot_1_every_sound.png@@

Every waveform is a shipped file: the emotes down the side, the voices across, two takes of each.

@@IMG:shot_2_every_balloon.png@@

The number in the file name is the balloon id, and each emote is one gesture.

@@IMG:shot_5_mz_plugin.png@@

The engine draws a balloon and plays nothing. The plugin fills that gap with nothing to add to an event.

Works with

RPG Maker MZ: copy the ogg files into audio/se, add the plugin and pick a voice. Tested in the MZ 1.10.0 runtime with stock scripts. It also catches balloons from other plugins that call the engine's own balloon request. Unity, Unreal, Godot 4, GameMaker, RPG Maker MV and HTML5: use the WAV or OGG files directly. Import notes are in the readme.

Try it free

The demo on this page holds 4 emotes in all 4 voices, plus the plugin set up to play them.

Licence and how it was made

Royalty free for commercial games, no credit required. Do not resell the sounds as a pack. Every sound is synthesised in code. No generative audio model was used; the code and the cover art were made with AI tools.

Versions

v1.0.0: first release, 120 sounds.

More from the same studio

  • Blip: Dialogue Voices, voiced text blips for the same dialogue.
  • Babble 01: Syllabic Dialogue Voices, a spoken gibberish cast.
  • Overdub: RPG Maker MZ Default Sound Replacement, new stock sounds for MZ.

Made by Core Systems Asset Factory.
